why: RJ-X45, pending IM-10 (suiteui/suite-imaging): neither catalog can set a tone by command yet (Photo has no adjust.set, Library no develop.set), Library's Saturation waits on creative-core until IM-10 runs ImagingProgram.adjustments, and the harness runs one app per job, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. Opens beach.png (64 x 48 sRGB: sky, sea and sand bands) in Photo and in Library, sets Exposure +1 stop and Saturation -50 in each, and exports a PNG from each. The trap: the same slider gives a different picture in each app (gamma read as its reciprocal, saturation missing, levels units mixed). The assertion: the two exports match within 1 level per channel and both differ clearly from the original; the turn-on adds the two commands, runs the stages in order, compares out/beach-library.png against out/beach-photo.png, and sets platforms to linux and macos.
